item.title: Inflation eases, but retailers face ongoing cost pressures as rates burden persists
item.description: The UK’s headline inflation rate falling to 3 per cent in January, its lowest level in ten months, offers some relief for retailers and consumers alike. But while price pressures are easing, costs remain elevated, household budgets are still stretched, and structural pressures such as business rates continue to weigh on profitability. item.title: Lidl opens five new stores in a day
item.description: Lidl GB will open five new stores in a single day, a move that will "reinforce" its position as the UK's "fastest growing" bricks-and-mortar food retailer.

item.description: Amazon has begun construction on its first delivery station designed to achieve Living Future’s Zero Carbon certification in the UK and Europe. The 10,800m² delivery station, which is based in Stockton-on-Tees, will “incorporate advanced building techniques to help reduce its environmental impact,” according to Amazon.
